'''Gantry AA7''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] complex located at the [[Trellik Hive]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]] ''[[Lucky Guess]]'' was landed there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LongArm" />
